Message:
kvm: vmx: Skip all SYSCALL MSRs in setup_msrs() when !EFER.SCE

Like IA32_STAR, IA32_LSTAR and IA32_FMASK only need to contain guest
values on VM-entry when the guest is in long mode and EFER.SCE is set.
